Container.Name: playroom
Container.Overview: Self-hosted video game collection: Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo in one place. Covers, playtime, achievements and trophies, an activity calendar and your backlog. On first launch, open the web UI and enter the setup code printed in the container logs.
Container.Requires: Open the container logs on first start to read the one-time setup code.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Account, API keys, notes and history. Back it up: it contains secrets.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used to split days in the activity calendar.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when HTTPS is handled by a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik).

Config.Name: Sync interval (hours)
Config.Description: Automatic sync every X hours, 0 to disable.
